company.name: Stoke Space
company.shortDescription: Stoke Space develops fully reusable Nova rockets for orbital space mobility.
company.description: Stoke Space develops the Nova rocket, a fully reusable launch vehicle designed to provide affordable access to and from Earth's orbit. The vehicle features a reusable upper stage that enables on-demand access to any orbit for cargo, logistics, and asset operations. Stoke Space operates vertically integrated design and manufacturing to build and rapidly iterate on its rocket engines and structures.

aiResearchSummary.text: Stoke Space is developing an atmospheric re-entry vehicle with a skewed heat shield optimized for high enthalpy flow and a reusable upper stage rocket with a high pressure chamber and specialized nozzle for controlled re-entry. They work on a reusable space vehicle for long-dwell payload hosting and orbital maneuvers using pressure-fed cryogenic propulsion, and a thin-walled curved shell tank and vehicle structure. Together these efforts focus on re-entry vehicles, reusable upper stages, orbital vehicles, and lightweight structures.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $860,000,000, or 61.6% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $1,750,000, representing 0.13% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,524,616 to $2,000,000,000, a 128.83x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
